description: 2013 Tropical Cyclone 03A Path is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). This layer shows the movement path of Tropical Cyclone 03A. 2013 TC03A formed off the north-east coast of Somalia across the Indian Ocean, moving directly towards the coast of the country in the following days. The storm produced a wind speed of 74 kph (46 mph) and (100-200)mm of rain. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Its tags are flooding, geodata, hazards and risk. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
